SUPERSEDES: ANSWER_PROBE_GATE_V1 (evidence/gate_executive/exec_training_v1_execute.receipts.gate_result.json) -- V1 is kept PERMANENTLY as valid negative evidence, not deleted or overwritten. V1's own diagnosis (separation stop-gate CLEARED, trained gate FAILED to beat fixed baselines) is the reason this follow-up exists: the failure localizes to policy estimation on an under-powered, non-outcome-stratified 144-task split, not to absence of a routing signal. See RESEARCH_STATUS.json answer_probe_gate_v1 for the full V1 record.
ONE_DISCIPLINED_ATTEMPT_NOT_OPEN_ENDED_T: This is a single, fully specified follow-up. If V2 also fails to beat the fixed baselines despite a larger, outcome-stratified dataset and a policy objective aligned to the asymmetric cost, that closes the confidence-only-gating approach specifically (not the executive concept in general) -- the next avenue would be a richer but still-cheap decision state (e.g. a retrieval probe before the full graph/memory operation), which is out of scope for this protocol and would require its own separately frozen design.
WHAT_STAYS_UNCHANGED: CERTIFIED_MEMORY_V1, the graph, the composer, retrieval, HRM, and the cheap ANSWER_NOW confidence probe (hrm_adaptive_memory/executive/confidence.py) itself are NOT modified. This protocol is scoped entirely to (a) a larger, outcome-balanced training pool and (b) a broader-but-still-simple model ladder with a policy-utility promotion test.

PHASE_1_SUITE_CONSTRUCTION.rule: Frozen BEFORE any scoring occurs -- task CONTENT is fixed by construction rules decided now, never selected or filtered based on a task's own measured outcome. Zero privileged-parsing bypass anywhere (same discipline as exec_training_v1): every task must round-trip through the REAL, unmodified extract_subject/extract_target_relation with zero synthetic identity injection.
PHASE_1_SUITE_CONSTRUCTION.do_not_reuse: The consumed exec_training_v1 144-task split (data/hrm/exec_training_v1/) is NOT resampled, re-included, or merged into V2's training/calibration/eval pool under any circumstance. It remains available only as historical diagnostic evidence, per its own SPLIT_LINEAGE.json (training_consumed, diagnosis_only/hypothesis_generation_only).

ANSWER_NOW_viable.v1_baseline: 72 tasks (36 capitals + 36 element symbols). Diagnostic re-analysis of V1's own receipts shows this family produced ALL 5 of V1's ANSWER_strict_win cases (6.9% incidence within-family) and only 2 MEMORY_strict_win cases (2.8%) -- it is the near-exclusive source of the 'direct answer sufficient, memory would not help or would hurt' signal.

expansion_plan_for_build_phase.note: same 36 elements as element_symbols, distinct relation ('atomic number') -- a genuinely different (subject, relation) tuple, zero overlap with the existing element_symbols task set
countries with a single, stable, unambiguous currency name -- excludes any country with disputed/recently-changed currency
excludes transcontinental countries (e.g. Russia, Turkey) to avoid ambiguity
all 50 US states -- stable, unambiguous, well-documented

ANSWER_NOW_viable.hand_verification_requirement: Every new fact, in every new category, must be individually hand-verified true (not merely internally consistent) and pass verify_native_parsing() against the real extract_subject/extract_target_relation before acceptance -- same discipline as hrm_adaptive_memory/experiments/exec_training_dataset.py's existing tables. Ambiguous relations (e.g. official language, where many countries have multiple) are explicitly EXCLUDED from this expansion for that reason.

MEMORY_required.v1_baseline: 72 tasks sampled from data/hrm/b3_calibration_v1. Diagnostic re-analysis: 48.6% MEMORY_strict_win incidence within-family, 51.4% tie, 0% ANSWER_strict_win.
MEMORY_required.source: data/hrm/b3_calibration_v1, same procedural sampling approach as V1/EOB-v1/EOB-v2/g2_confirmation_2, with FRESH seeds outside every previously consumed range (scale-namespaced per the fix already applied for EOB-v2's task_id collision, verified via a hard uniqueness assertion before any GPU run)
MEMORY_required.note: Procedurally cheap to scale (unlike ANSWER_NOW_viable, which requires individual hand-verification) -- this is where most of V1's real statistical weakness lived: only 37 MEMORY_strict_win examples total, spread thin across a non-outcome-stratified 70/30 split. At 700 tasks and the same within-family incidence rate, expect roughly 340 MEMORY_strict_win examples pool-wide -- an order of magnitude more than V1.

projected_pool_composition_extrapolated_.caveat: Extrapolated from V1's small per-family base rates (72 each) -- treated as a planning estimate only, not a target to hit exactly. The realized rates at 320/700 scale are an empirical question this protocol's own Phase 2 collection answers.
projected_pool_composition_extrapolated_.MEMORY_strict_win_est: ~349 (17 from ANSWER_NOW_viable + 292 from MEMORY_required, ~34.2% of pool)
projected_pool_composition_extrapolated_.honest_limitation: ANSWER_strict_win is expected to remain the thin class even at this scale (~22 total vs V1's 5) -- its natural incidence is family-specific (only ANSWER_NOW_viable produces it) and further scaling is bottlenecked by hand-verification of genuinely unambiguous GK facts, not compute. This protocol compensates via disproportionate stratified allocation to eval/calibration for this specific class (PHASE_3) and via a class-weighted/value-regression model ladder (PHASE_4) rather than by pretending literal count-parity across the three outcome classes is achievable without reintroducing the privileged-parsing bypass this project has explicitly ruled out for training data. If ANSWER_strict_win representation is still the binding constraint after real collection, that is itself informative and must be classified via MINIMUM_CLASS_FLOOR_NOT_MET (PHASE_5), not silently absorbed.

PHASE_1_SUITE_CONSTRUCTION.audit_discipline: Independently re-verify zero overlap after the builder script's own audit, not merely trusting it -- same standing practice used for every prior split in this project.

PHASE_2_COLLECTION.rule: Run the full 2-action collection (A0_ANSWER_NOW with confidence features, A1_USE_CERTIFIED_MEMORY via the unmodified certified pipeline) exactly once against the complete frozen pool. Freeze raw receipts immediately. This is the ONLY phase in which delta_u_i becomes known -- everything in PHASE_1 and PHASE_3's split RULE must be decided before this phase runs.
PHASE_2_COLLECTION.certified_memory_v1_identity_check: Required live, before every task, exactly as V1 did -- fail-closed on any drift.

PHASE_3_OUTCOME_STRATIFIED_SPLIT.rule_frozen_before_phase_2_runs: A mechanical, predetermined stratification rule -- applied automatically to whatever outcome labels Phase 2 produces, with zero human selection of which examples land where. This is stratified sampling by a measured outcome variable (standard practice for imbalanced classification), NOT cherry-picking: the population (Phase 1's task set) is fixed before any outcome exists, and the allocation percentages below are fixed before Phase 2 runs.

ANSWER_strict_win.why_different: Deliberately shifts weight toward calibration+eval for this rarest, most statistically fragile class -- rather than spending the bulk of its scarce examples on training, since a class-weighted model can still learn a useful boundary from a modest but non-trivial train share, while the ONE-SHOT promotion test specifically needs enough eval representation to make P(ACCEPT | delta_u>0)-adjacent estimates non-degenerate. Not tuned to a target eval count after seeing Phase 2 data -- this ratio is fixed now.

PHASE_3_OUTCOME_STRATIFIED_SPLIT.note: Distinct from V1's plain 70/30-by-suite_family split (seed 9801) -- V2 stratifies by suite_family AND by realized outcome sign, addressing the exact defect V1's own diagnosis identified (thin, non-stratified minority-class representation in both train and eval).

PHASE_4_MODEL_LADDER.rule: Broader than V1's single logistic regression, but still deliberately simple -- no neural controller.

ladder.name: best_fixed_action
ladder.description: max(U(always_accept), U(always_escalate)) -- the baseline every learned policy must beat

ladder.name: frozen_confidence_threshold
ladder.description: single scalar cutoff on mean_token_confidence, fit on TRAIN only

ladder.name: ordinary_logistic_regression
ladder.description: unweighted, all 5 features, same fitting approach as ANSWER_PROBE_GATE_V1 -- kept as a direct replication check

ladder.name: cost_sensitive_logistic_regression
ladder.description: PRIMARY learned hypothesis. Class-weighted logistic regression: base weight = inverse TRAIN-partition class frequency (standard 'balanced' weighting, computed mechanically from the realized TRAIN split's own counts -- not hand-picked), with an ADDITIONAL frozen 2.0x multiplier applied specifically to the escalation-helps (delta_u>0) class on top of balanced weighting. Both the weighting RULE and the 2.0x multiplier are frozen in this document, before any V2 data exists -- only the resulting numeric weight value is a deterministic function of TRAIN's realized counts.
ladder.cost_multiplier_justification: V1's own asymmetric-error report showed the dangerous miss rate (P(ACCEPT|memory would improve)=0.7778) was catastrophically worse than the wasted-call rate (P(ESCALATE|direct sufficient)=0.1143) -- a real, observed asymmetry in the DIRECTION this multiplier corrects. 2.0x is a moderate, round, pre-registered correction in that direction; it is not solved-for to reproduce any specific target number.

ladder.name: shallow_tree_diagnostic
ladder.description: small nonlinear diagnostic (max_depth<=3, e.g. simple axis-aligned decision tree over the 5 features) -- reported for comparison, NOT eligible for promotion on its own (per MODEL_LADDER discipline, complexity beyond logistic regression is diagnostic-only unless a documented, separately-frozen follow-up specifically escalates to it)

ladder.name: oracle_escalation
ladder.description: per-task argmax, tie->ACCEPT (same convention as V1/EOB-v1/EOB-v2) -- ceiling reference, not a candidate for promotion

ladder.name: value_regression
ladder.description: regresses delta_u_i directly (continuous target, fit on TRAIN, squared-error loss) instead of a binary label -- escalates when predicted delta_u exceeds a frozen-on-CALIBRATION threshold. Evaluated alongside the classification ladder as a genuinely different hypothesis: that predicting the MAGNITUDE of expected gain, not just its sign, produces a better escalation boundary than any binary classifier in this ladder.

PHASE_4_MODEL_LADDER.primary_learned_hypothesis: V3 (cost_sensitive_logistic_regression). VR1 is a co-primary secondary hypothesis reported with equal rigor, not a fallback -- if VR1 promotes and V3 does not, that is itself a real, reportable finding about which target formulation (binary vs continuous) carries more usable signal.

train_calibration_eval_separation.calibration: freeze decision threshold (V1/V2/V3/VR1) and the realized V3 class-weight VALUE (the weighting rule is frozen in this document; its numeric value is computed from TRAIN counts; the resulting decision threshold is then chosen on CALIBRATION) -- never on TRAIN (overfits the threshold to training noise) or EVAL (invalidates the one-shot promotion test)
train_calibration_eval_separation.eval: ONE-SHOT promotion test only. Computed exactly once, no iteration back to threshold/weight choices after seeing eval numbers.

PHASE_5_PROMOTION_CRITERIA.primary_metric: Delta_U_gate = U(candidate) - max(U(E0/V0 always_accept), U(E1/V0 always_escalate)) on EVAL, same definition as V1
PHASE_5_PROMOTION_CRITERIA.utility_condition: Delta_U_gate > 0 with a positive grouped-bootstrap LCB (resampled by suite_family, same convention as V1/EOB-v1/EOB-v2/HRM qualification)

hard_safety_bound.rule: must be <= 0.30 -- the candidate must correctly escalate on at least 70% of held-out cases where memory was actually needed
hard_safety_bound.justification: Chosen now, before any V2 data exists, independent of V1's observed 0.7778. Substantially stricter than V1's result (which this protocol exists to fix) but deliberately not near-zero (e.g. 0.05), since a bound that tight would force the gate to behave almost identically to always-escalate, defeating the purpose of having a gate. 0.30 leaves room for a real ACCEPT decision on the ~66-70% of low-risk cases while bounding the dangerous-miss rate to a level a research lead would consider acceptable for a system that still has always-escalate as a fallback comparator in every report.

minimum_class_floor_for_a_trustworthy_ev.rule: If Phase 2's realized outcome counts, after the Phase 3 stratified split, leave EITHER floor unmet in the eval partition, the promotion test is NOT trustworthy regardless of its point estimate. Classify this outcome as MINIMUM_CLASS_FLOOR_NOT_MET (a new, distinct FailureClass, to be added to result_schema.py at the time this outcome is actually observed, per this project's standing practice of adding FailureClass values when a run produces them, not speculatively) -- explicitly NOT the same finding as 'the policy failed'; it means the promotion TEST itself lacked power, and is reported as inconclusive, not negative.
minimum_class_floor_for_a_trustworthy_ev.floors_chosen_because: 40 is roughly half of V1's ENTIRE pool-wide count of that class (37) -- a real, substantial improvement, not a token increase. 10 for ANSWER_strict_win is set lower given the disclosed hand-curation ceiling on that class (PHASE_1's honest_limitation note), but is still double V1's total eval-adjacent count (9).

promotion_requires_all_of: utility_condition met for the primary hypothesis (V3) or the co-primary hypothesis (VR1)
hard_safety_bound met for whichever of V3/VR1 is being promoted
both minimum_class_floor entries met (otherwise: MINIMUM_CLASS_FLOOR_NOT_MET, inconclusive, not negative)
PHASE_5_PROMOTION_CRITERIA.if_promoted: Generate a fresh, completely untouched executive-confirmation split (never before touched by any experiment in this project) and run the promoted policy exactly once, per the qualification-then-confirmation discipline already used for CERTIFIED_MEMORY_V1 and every gate in this project.
PHASE_5_PROMOTION_CRITERIA.if_not_met_and_floors_were_met: This closes the confidence-only escalation-gating approach specifically. Report as a second formal negative result with the same rigor as V1 -- do not attempt a V3 of this protocol without a new, separately justified change in kind (e.g. a richer but still-cheap decision state such as a retrieval probe), not merely more tuning of the same feature set.

ASYMMETRIC_ERROR_METRICS_REQUIRED.P_accept_given_memory_would_improve: primary safety metric, see hard_safety_bound above -- never folded into aggregate accuracy
ASYMMETRIC_ERROR_METRICS_REQUIRED.P_escalate_given_direct_sufficient: wasted/harmful-memory-call rate, reported for every model in the ladder, same as V1
